newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Fiserv initiated as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Fiserv initiated as buy.

text.p: - Dain Bosworth Inc said Tuesday it initiated coverage of Fiserv Inc with a buy rating.
- Dain Bosworth estimates 1997 earnings at $1.63 a share versus $1.34 in 1996.

"With 1996 sales of nearly $800 million and earnings of $61.6 million, the company is poised to grow even larger via its aggressive and successful acquisition strategy," the firm said in a statement, adding the company generated $2.86 of cash flow per share from operations.
- Fiserv, a financial service systems vendor based in Brookfield, Wisconsin, "can continue to grow and be a survivor and leader in the financial services field," Dain Bosworth said.
- Dain Bosworth has set a one-year price target of $44 a share.
- Shares of Fiserv traded off 9/16 at 37-3/8.
